items.prompt: Create a production environment concept reference, stylized-concept / style-transfer. Treat the supplied real Hong Kong photographs as evidence for practical shop organization and the supplied earlier storefront concept as the shared architectural/material style. Transfer into the dense, lived-in Kowloon city atmosphere of Ghost in the Shell's 1995 urban backgrounds: detailed painted environmental art, subdued olive/teal shadows, aged timber, nicotine ivory, dusty red awning, warm practical light, layered pipes and wiring, tiny amber/green electronics; restrained, no giant neon spectacle. Preserve usable shop circulation and credible human scale. No identifiable real shop names or copied branding, no readable text required. Show just one ground-floor shop, not a whole building. Wide landscape image with a large street-facing three-quarter view taking 70% and a smaller roof-off oblique layout study taking 30%; same exact layout in both panels, no labels necessary. This is art direction to guide a procedural model, not a photograph or a render of current code. Subject: deep Hong Kong provisions/liquor shop, roughly 4.8m wide by 6.2m deep. Mainly chunky wooden shelves with 4cm-thick visibly solid board edges and 50cm-deep decks, mixed heights and uneven bay widths, plus just one narrow subtly weathered metal rack at the doorway. No thin skeletal all-metal supermarket racks. Bottles, tins, jars, paper cartons and sacks grouped densely but with real gaps and depth. A distinct small wooden cashier counter on the front-right side, cream vintage cash register with a small green display, receipt roll, ledger, bagging space; 85–100cm customer aisle leading into the store, 75cm clear staff access behind cashier. Low central timber stock fixture ending short of checkout so customers can turn and queue. Taller bottle crates flank entrance but do not block it. Deep side and rear timber storage, wall fan and old calendar. Fine narrow shelf-edge scuffing, faint small brown rust only at metal joints, aged wood rather than white flaky metal. No people so arrangement is inspectable.
